second_source.locator: Table 1, p. 1226: up = P2 / tp^P3 with P2 = 0.64 and P3 = 1.04, 'dependent on the interval of estimation'

discrepancy: the relation between up and tp depends on the computation step dt: KZGW's eq. 6.19 (0.66 / tp^1.04) holds for dt -> 0 and Sikorska et al. state that P2 and P3 depend on the interval, while the example uses the relation of dt = 1 h (0.464 / tp^0.824). The spec keeps the instantaneous relation and averages the IUH over dt exactly; the example's route gives a unit hydrograph peak of 0.771 m3/s per mm against 0.989 (+28 %), and its design flood 13.66 m3/s against 14.03 (+2.7 %). Only Lutz (1984), not open to Hydrolog, can tell which relations of dt the method intends
